name: storage
title: Storage
description: R2-backed file storage for Lunora — direct-upload + worker-signed-URL helpers built on @lunora/storage over an R2 bucket binding, exposed as actions/queries so codegen surfaces them as api.storage.*.
docs: Add an R2 bucket named in wrangler.jsonc (binding UPLOADS) and set STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET (>= 32 chars) + STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL (a bare origin, no path), then re-export the functions from lunora/storage/index.ts so codegen emits api.storage.generateUploadUrl / api.storage.getDownloadUrl / api.storage.deleteObject / api.storage.listObjects. Add the /storage/* route to your Worker entry — it verifies signed URLs and handles both the PUT the browser uploads with and the GET it downloads with (see the README).

envVars.name: STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET
envVars.description: HMAC secret used to sign/verify storage URLs (min 32 chars). Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Must NOT be shared across buckets/tenants.

envVars.name: STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Bare origin that fronts the R2 bucket (the Worker or CDN host that serves the signed URLs). MUST NOT carry a path: the key is verified from the whole URL pathname, so a subpath base makes every minted URL fail verification. Every key this item mints is prefixed `storage/`, so the minted URLs land on `/storage/:key` at this origin.
